messages:
Priya: Quick shift wrap — posting current state so next oncall has context. TL;DR: embed-cache latency incident still showing brief spikes, mitigations applied, next steps below.

Jon: Status update — error rate down from ~21% to ~2% after activating KV-cache fallback and throttling batch size. 95p latency reduced from ~420ms -> ~110ms.

Alex: Root cause looks like mempressure on p3-small pool during long requests. I scaled the pool +2 nodes and tightened container memory requests. Applied a canary: 50% traffic -> 100% over 10m.

Priya: Opened INF-4821 for tracking. Assigned Alex for immediate follow-up, Sophia for RCA/postmortem. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-latency (please use).

Sophia: I'll own RCA. Plan: reproduce with perf harness, re-run with new kernel + quantized kernel selection, and validate caching TTLs. Scheduled perf run 10:30 PT, will post logs.

Oncall Bot: INF-4821 severity downgraded to S2 after error rate drop. Automated fallback policy triggered at 1843056795.

Jon: Note — retry queue briefly spiked; rehydration rate currently ~750/min. Watching.

Priya: Action item for infra: add cron to run kvcache reclaim every 6h. I filed INF-4822 for infra-ops.

Mike: I start next shift at 00:00 UTC. I'll check the retry queue and run the quick checklist: /runbooks/embed-latency -> steps 1-5 and confirm rehydration <1k/min.

Mike: Quick checks done (post-handoff): rehydration 680/min, 95p latency 115ms, no new errors in last 5m. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Alex to validate scale change is stable (monitor next 2h), Sophia to post RCA summary, Mike to escalate if errors >5% or rehydration >1k/min. Leaving handoff notes in weekly ops doc.

Jon: Added small monitoring alert tweak to reduce false positives on transient spikes. Patch in PR #7890.

Priya: Signing off. @Mike you have the bridge keys and runbook. Ping if anything surfaces.
